inputRootSignature: theorem ridge_regression_mean_squared_error {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (P : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure P] (n d : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) (hd : 1 ≤ d) (X : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin d) ℝ) (betaStar : Fin d → ℝ) (epsilon : Ω → Fin n → ℝ) (hε_L2 : MemLp epsilon 2 P) (sigmaSq : ℝ) (hsigma : 0 ≤ sigmaSq) (hmean : ∫ ω, epsilon ω ∂P = 0) (hcov : ∀ i j, ∫ ω, epsilon ω i * epsilon ω j ∂P = if i = j then sigmaSq else 0) (lambda : ℝ) (hlambda : 0 < lambda) : let A : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ := X.transpose * X + lambda • 1 let y : Ω → Fin n → ℝ := fun ω ↦ X *ᵥ betaStar + epsilon ω let betaHat : Ω → Fin d → ℝ := fun ω ↦ A⁻¹ *ᵥ (X.transpose *ᵥ y ω) ∫ ω, dotProduct (betaHat ω - betaStar) (betaHat ω - betaStar) ∂P = lambda ^ 2 * dotProduct (A⁻¹ *ᵥ betaStar) (A⁻¹ *ᵥ betaStar) + sigmaSq * (A⁻¹ * X.transpose * X * A⁻¹).trace
